articles.title: Foresight AI Brings Gremlin Agents to Reliability Engineering
articles.author: Matt Saunders
articles.summary: Reliability management company Gremlin has announced the general availability of Foresight AI, an agentic product that analyses services for potential failures, recommends changes and reruns tests to check that a fix works. By Matt Saunders

articles.title: AWS Introduces Enhanced Custom Event Buses for EventBridge
articles.author: Renato Losio
articles.summary: AWS recently announced enhanced custom event buses for Amazon EventBridge, allowing organizations to share a centralized bus across accounts with ordered delivery, simplified subscriber management, event replay, content-based deduplication, and a new publisher/subscriber-based pricing model. By Renato Losio
